recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中大量標靶細胞（target cells）與摺疊、不規則收縮的紅血球，並可見紅血球內呈深紅色棒狀、六角形的 HbC 結晶（像金條），沒有鐮刀狀細胞，符合同合子血紅素 C 病。
features: Numerous target cells (codocytes) throughout the field
Intraerythrocytic dense, dark red rod-shaped to hexagonal HbC crystals with parallel sides
Folded and irregularly contracted red cells and some microspherocytes
Scattered platelets; no nucleated red cells in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a prominent population of target cells together with folded, irregularly contracted and spherocytic erythrocytes. Several red cells contain dense, dark-staining, straight-edged rod or hexagonal crystals with the red cell membrane closely applied, characteristic of hemoglobin C crystals. Sickled cells are not identified. Findings are consistent with homozygous hemoglobin C disease; confirmation by hemoglobin electrophoresis or HPLC is recommended.

ddx.vs: HbSC shows irregular crystals with blunt finger-like projections ('Washington monument' or 'glove' forms) and occasional sickle cells.
HbSS shows many elongated sickle cells and Howell-Jolly bodies rather than tetragonal crystals.

ddx.dx: Thalassemia or liver disease with target cells
ddx.vs: Target cells in thalassemia are accompanied by microcytosis and basophilic stippling, and in liver disease by acanthocytes, without HbC crystals.
HbC trait has fewer target cells, no anemia and rarely shows crystals, and HPLC shows about 40% HbC with HbA.
